description: Check whether a Vietnamese facility must do a mandatory greenhouse-gas (GHG) inventory under Decree 06/2022 (amended by 119/2025) and the 2026 list (Decision 42/2026/QĐ-TTg). Thresholds: 3,000 tCO2e, 1,000 TOE or 65,000 t of waste per year.

annualElectricityKwh.description: Annual electricity use in kWh (used if TOE is unknown; converted at 0.0001543 TOE/kWh per Appendix I of Circular 02/2014/TT-BCT, so 1,000 TOE ≈ 6.48 million kWh).

annualEmissionsTco2e.description: Annual GHG emissions in tonnes CO2e.

annualEnergyToe.description: Annual energy use in TOE (tonnes of oil equivalent).

sector.description: cong-nghiep (industry), nhiet-dien (power), van-tai (freight transport), toa-nha (commercial building), chat-thai (solid waste), khac (other).

name: check_ghg_inventory_obligation
title: Check GHG inventory obligation (Vietnam)
